perDrugAssumptions.classification: All demand, price, share, launch, net realization and clinical probabilities below are research assumptions, not issuer forecasts or verified epidemiological counts. Three-element arrays are bear/base/bull.
perDrugAssumptions.method: peakCNYbn = addressable treated patients * annual realized product priceCNY * share / 1e9. Addressable patients are selected financially accessible severe/residual segments across China and potential overseas markets, not total prevalence. netRate models retained realization after hypothetical partner/channel leakage; GM deducts production costs and riskSellingRate deducts incremental selling. No invented future licensing milestone is added.
perDrugAssumptions.probabilityPolicy: BIO 2011-2020 reported Phase I-to-approval probability about 7.9% overall; these are preclinical research judgments by evidence, mechanism and indication, not a literal use of phase benchmarks or issuer clinical predictions. No human disease efficacy exists for these candidates; bear/base/bull encode scientific uncertainty. Earlier start or larger market does not establish probability.
perDrugAssumptions.costPolicy: All legacy clinical cost totals retained unallocated, including active assets. Each drug clinical row remains zero to prevent arbitrary allocation and duplicate cost. Additional demand does not imply this old total proves adequate development funding; +30%/+100% clinical budget sensitivities are required.
perDrugAssumptions.ownershipPolicy: Group own-development and wholly-owned Ailux support 100% retained ownership as a research assumption, not proof of unencumbered net economics. 0%/50%/100% ownership sensitivity changes revenue only while retaining total costs; no unsupported licensing milestone.
perDrugAssumptions.overlapPolicy: XTN004 IBS and residual IBD pain separate selected symptomatic populations; ALX001 underlying inflammatory IBD therapy may coexist and is not counted as a cure of the same pain market. ALX002 RA population is refractory B-cell-driven segment, narrower than total RA; ALX005 MG/ITP separate diagnoses. Shared drug early development costs are never repeated by indication.

rows.reason: pre-IND gut-restricted pain candidate; low priced symptomatic treatment faces generics and placebo sensitivity; selected refractory IBS demand, not all IBS.
residual pain adjunct among IBD patients; disease anti-inflammatory effect is not assumed. Launch later than IBS; same molecule safety risk correlated.
TL1A/IL23p19 bispecific, 2027 phase I plan; large market but competition from IL23/JAK/TL1A and no comparative clinical evidence. IBD remains one disclosed indication; no unsupported UC/CD split.
CD19/BCMA/CD3 T-cell engager; selected refractory SLE, cytokine risk and durability unknown; annual equivalent price includes retreatment risk and does not assume permanent cure.
refractory B-cell-mediated RA only; established TNF/JAK/CD20 alternatives and tolerance to toxicity reduce achievable share and development probability versus SLE.
FcRn/HSA long acting design, validated class does not prove candidate safety; selected antibody-mediated MG eligible for costly therapy, competition caps share.
refractory IgG-mediated ITP subset; TPO agonist and B-cell therapy competition, response durability and bleeding outcome distinct from MG.
